citations.cites: Exclusion E-15 and exception for storm ingress

facts: Heavy rain of 66 mm in 24 hours on 2025-03-14
Water entered the basement through the window frame
note: The loss meets the definition of storm ingress as surface water entering through a window during a storm exceeding 50 mm rainfall in 24 hours [HO-0304_01-25#02]. The flood exclusion does not apply because the endorsement provides an exception for storm ingress, which is payable up to the Storm Ingress Allowance [HO-0304_01-25#05]. The policy sets a Storm Ingress Allowance sub‑limit of $5,000 per storm within Coverage A [HO-0304_01-25#07].
